g.text: Baseline: cd985f42b. Current: 69a49d116 + validated uncommitted long-string decoder. Original 12.6 has no parseAsync.

g.text: Six rotated rounds; 2 warmups + 9 measured batches per process. Median of process medians. Four-job sync is serial; async awaits all four.
